Flash Loan is a loan that is borrowed and repaid within a single blockchain transaction. Flash Loan requires no collateral from the borrower. Flash Loan is offered by lending protocols on public blockchains and is executed by smart contracts.

Puppet is a lending pool that requires borrowers to deposit collateral. Puppet determines collateral prices from a Uniswap V1 pool.

0x is a protocol for decentralized exchange of ERC-20 tokens on Ethereum. 0x uses off-chain signed orders that are settled on-chain.

OasisDEX is an on-chain order book decentralized exchange on Ethereum. OasisDEX matches limit orders that are stored in smart contracts.
